findings.text: A single OOF partition is not population truth for 85 molecules. With the feature block fixed, five independent five-fold partitions gave MAEs of 0.207, 0.198, 0.209, 0.206 and 0.199 kcal mol$^{-1}$, a mean of \RepeatMean{} $\pm$ \RepeatSD{} kcal mol$^{-1}$ (Fig.~\ref{fig:robustness}a). Repeating nested feature selection gave \NestedRepeatMean{} $\pm$ \NestedRepeatSD{} kcal mol$^{-1}$. SolvAI therefore reaches a strict sub-0.20 point estimate and centers near the PIMD8 result across repeats, but robust sub-0.20 generalization has not been established.

The primary reference set is small, and method development occurred in its context. The frozen result should not be read as a universal hydration benchmark or as a generic FreeSolv state-of-the-art claim. It is a controlled AI-versus-PIMD comparison on the exact molecular set used to establish the ARROW/PIMD8 result. Within that scope, aligned response priors remove most of the gap between direct structure learning and high-fidelity simulation while preserving a one-SMILES deployment interface.
